text.description_html:
Omnia Andrea Contemporary Styled Round Ring Door Knocker

Omnia's Door Knockers add those details, those distinctive touches which claify and reinforce fine architecture and design. Their dedication to detail is revealed this 6" solid brass Ring door knocker.

After hand polishing and high buffing, a hard and transparent lacquer is baked onto each piece. This special process retains the tradition of old world excellence while employing the best available modern technology to protect and preserve your fine taste.

Specifications for Omnia 76/80-US3 Door Knocker

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Overall Size: 6-1/2"
  • Center to Center mounting screws: 3-5/8"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Backplate Diameter: 3-13/16"
  • Ring Diameter: 4-1/2"
  • US3 Polished Brass Finish

*Sold individually.
